title: Array-Vector Multiply
source_docs: DSP System Toolbox/Math Functions/Matrices and Linear Algebra/Matrix Operations/Array_Vector_Multiply.md
text: 沿指定维度将数组乘以向量，输入 2 路、输出 1 路、无直接馈通；按 {Rounding mode} 指定舍入运算的方法；{Multiply along dimension} 指定沿其乘以输入数组的维度、{Vector (V) source} 指定向量来源 Input、{Vector (V)} 指定向量参数、{Saturate on integer overflow} 指定溢出操作的方法、{Vector (V) Minimum} 指定向量元素的最小值、{Vector (V) Maximum} 指定向量元素的最大值、{Product output} 指定乘积输出数据类型、{Accumulator} 指定累加器数据类型、{Output} 输出数据类型、{Output Minimum} 指定模块输出的最小值、{Output Maximum} 指定模块输出的最大值、{Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型，按实例取值。

params.name: Multiply along dimension
params.values: 沿其乘以输入数组的维度 2 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Vector (V) source
params.values: 向量来源 Input port (default) | Dialog parameter

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: 舍入运算的方法 Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: 溢出操作的方法 off (default) | on

params.name: Vector (V) Minimum
params.values: 向量元素的最小值 [] (unspecified) (default) | scalar

params.name: Vector (V) Maximum
params.values: 向量元素的最大值 [] (unspecified) (default) | scalar

params.name: Product output
params.values: 乘积输出数据类型 Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as first input | fixdt([],16,0) |

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: 累加器数据类型 Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as first input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt([],16,0) |

params.name: Output
params.values: 输出数据类型 Inherit: Same as product output (default) | Inherit: Same as first input | Inherit: Same as first input | fixdt([],16,0) |

params.name: Output Minimum
params.values: 模块输出的最小值 [] (unspecified) (default) | scalar

params.name: Output Maximum
params.values: 模块输出的最大值 [] (unspecified) (default) | scalar

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型 off (default) | on
